stories.title: CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
stories.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have urged users to discontinue using a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library named Idunno.AntiCsrf ("Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll") following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild. stories.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: VMware 0-Day, Java4Shell, NGINX2Root, Ruby2Shell, and a Whole Lot of Shell Trouble
stories.summary: A stolen key. A trusted message. A routine update. None of these looks like the start of a major security problem. That's partly why they work. stories.title: Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach
stories.summary: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes.

stories.title: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
stories.summary: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices, with some affected users reporting backdoors and reverse shells giving remote access to infected devices.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ScreenConnect Flaw to Hijack MSP Technician PCs Without Warning
stories.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a now-patched security flaw in ConnectWise ScreenConnect to target managed service provider (MSP) servers. The activity revolves around CVE-2026-84869 (CVSS score: 9.9), a critical ScreenConnect client flaw that allows a guest to transfer and execute a malicious payload on a connecting technician's host. stories.title: Microsoft confirms Windows printing issues affecting Forcepoint users
stories.summary: Microsoft confirmed printing issues on systems running Forcepoint DLP software after installing the KB5132043 November 2026 Windows 11 hotpatch.

stories.title: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks
stories.summary: Threat actors could exploit them to leak or modify server information and to execute commands as root.
